title: Issi, Father or Brother of Rabbi Zeira
author: Aharon Hyman
attribution: Model-assisted translation, editorially reviewed; publication authorized by Joshua Waxman.

paragraphs: He is mentioned in Moed Katan 20b: “But did not Issi, the father of Rabbi Zeira” — and some say, the brother of Rabbi Zeira — “recite a teaching before Rabbi Zeira…; Rabbi Zeira responded after him,” etc.[^1]

notes.text: The whole selected Davidson Moed Katan 20b paragraph explicitly gives Issi as the father of Rabbi Zeira, or according to an alternative, his brother, reciting before Rabbi Zeira. This supports the local expansion of ר״ז and preserves both alternatives. Hyman’s following response clause remains his abridgment; the reviewed scalar does not itself include that response. Reciting a teaching is not a new generation or teacher-relationship admission.
